chapter.verse: Topa phat un! Topa ’ tungah la thak sa un, a thuman mite’ kikhopna sungah amah phatna sa un!
Amah a Bawlpa’ tungah Israel lungdam hen la, amau Kumpipa’ sungah Zion mite kipak ta hen!
Laamna tawh ama min phat un la, khuang leh laiza lasakna tawh ama tungah langaih sa un!
Bang hang hiam cih leh ama mite tungah Topa lungdam a, miniamte gualzo sakin a pahtawi hi.
A gualzawhna uh-ah thuman mite lungdamin diang uh hen la, ama mai-ah khukdin-in, nuamna la sa uh hen.

Minamte tungah phu la-in mihingte daan pia ding, amau kumpite sikkhau tawh henin amau miliante sikkol bulh ding, a kigelhsa thukhenna bangin amaute tungah a semkhia dingin, lang nih-a hiam namsau a tawikawmin, Pasian phat-in awng ta uh hen! Hih in ama misiangthote’ minthan’na ahi hi. Topa phat un!
